Class ServerRMI

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.ServerRMI
All Implemented Interfaces:
RemoteClient, RemoteServer, Serializable, Remote
public class ServerRMI extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RemoteClient, RemoteServer
The ServerRMI class implements the RemoteClient and RemoteServer interfaces. It handles communication between the server and clients using RMI (Remote Method Invocation). This class manages client connections, processes commands, and monitors client heartbeats.
